  "private": true,

    "node": ">=22.19.0"

    "postinstall": "pnpm run build:packages",
    "build:packages": "cd packages/mathml2omml && npm run build && cd ../pptxgenjs && npm run build && cd ../@openmaic/dsl && pnpm run build && cd ../geometry && pnpm run build && cd ../generation && pnpm run build && cd ../storage && pnpm run build && cd ../importer && pnpm run build && cd ../renderer && pnpm run build && cd ../editor && pnpm run build && cd ../../.. && node scripts/sync-maic-importer.mjs && node scripts/sync-interactive-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-code-editor.mjs",
    "sync:maic-importer": "node scripts/sync-maic-importer.mjs",
    "build:standalone-player": "node scripts/build-standalone-player.mjs",
    "gen:video-export-katex": "node scripts/generate-video-export-katex.mjs",
    "gen:video-export-noto-cjk": "node scripts/generate-video-export-noto-cjk.mjs",
    "gen:video-export-noto-script-fonts": "node scripts/generate-video-export-noto-script-fonts.mjs",
    "dev": "node scripts/sync-interactive-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-code-editor.mjs && node scripts/build-standalone-player.mjs && next dev",
    "build": "node scripts/sync-interactive-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-code-editor.mjs && node scripts/assert-vendor-maic-importer.mjs && node scripts/build-standalone-player.mjs && next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "db:up": "docker compose -p openmaic-dev-db -f docker-compose.db.yml up -d --wait postgres",
    "db:down": "docker compose -p openmaic-dev-db -f docker-compose.db.yml stop postgres",
    "lint": "eslint",
    "check:i18n-keys": "node scripts/check-i18n-keys.mjs",
    "check:node-engine": "node scripts/check-node-engine-contract.mjs",
    "check:package-versions": "node scripts/check-package-version-bumps.mjs",
    "check": "prettier . --check",
    "format": "prettier . --write",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:package-tarballs": "node scripts/smoke-test-package-tarballs.mjs",
    "test:e2e": "playwright test",
    "test:e2e:ui": "playwright test --ui",
    "eval:pbl-v2-planner": "tsx eval/pbl-v2-planner/runner.ts",
    "eval:whiteboard": "tsx --conditions=import eval/whiteboard-layout/runner.ts",
    "eval:outline-language": "tsx eval/outline-language/runner.ts",
    "eval:orchestration:answering": "tsx --conditions=import eval/orchestration/answering-runner.ts",
    "eval:orchestration:answer-content": "tsx --conditions=import eval/orchestration/answer-content-runner.ts",
    "sync:interactive-assets": "node scripts/sync-interactive-assets.mjs",
    "sandbox:preview": "node --env-file=.env.local scripts/sandbox-preview-gateway.mjs"
